name: vrrqa
instructions: Treat VRR-QA as visual implicit-relation multiple choice, not open-ended VQA.
Ground every answer in visible entities, spatial relations, viewpoint, motion, temporal order, and object continuity.
For relation questions, first localize the target entities and then compare all options against the same evidence.
Do not use outside commonsense as the deciding evidence when the relation is not visible.
Return one valid option letter only.
